title: Weight decay 0.1 -> 0
description: AdamW weight decay off. Everything else as 001.
hypothesis: With 4 epochs of 155k records there is little overfitting pressure and decay on a 3M model mostly shrinks embeddings and the head, flattening the output distribution. Removing it could sharpen the model and change the T=0.8 sampling behaviour that drives EI. Low prior; this is mostly a probe of whether any optimizer-side knob moves the metric outside noise.
surprise: Pretrain and EI r1 identical to baseline again (greedy 0.933, r1 solved 76), eval 30. Same-config-looking runs now span 7, 30, 56, 67.
